fault_stage: business committed; before first atomic export replacement
recovery: same UUID; restart existing Worker Job or rerun direct command
timing: from submit/direct spawn through success and process shutdown; setup and terminal re-export excluded
policy: production defaults: 2 retries, 5/60 second backoff, 300 second timeout
gate: production GitHubHTTP, per-instance API flock, default budgets; fixed local transport
order: alternate TaskForge/direct ordering by repetition; compare semantics before timings
